title: Dermatologic Manifestations of Zika Virus
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether any diagnostic patterns exist in the symptom presentation of Zika Virus.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults aged 18 years and older presenting with febrile illness and rash

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients aged 17 years or younger
study_population: Adults 18 y/o with confirmed zika virus diagnosis
condition: Zika Virus Symptoms and the Associated Exanthema
